name: hcapp_setDirectMessagePreference
description: Records who may send the caller a direct message (E9.F1.S18): 0 friends only (the default), 1 anyone, 2 nobody. Stored in two bits of HC.Hasher.Preferences (0x4000|0x8000) which the SP read-modify-writes so no other bit is touched (the bitfield is overwritten whole by addEditUser, so every writer owns only its own bits — 2026-09-27 rule). The Hasher table's trigger moves updatedAt, so the phone receives the value in its next user sync. Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 128, @param NULL); the caller's own row only, no permission gate. Not transacted (a single UPDATE).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: preference
parameters.description: 0 friends only, 1 anyone, 2 nobody. Default NULL; NULL or any other value is refused with 2000. Written as (@preference * 16384) into bits 0x4000|0x8000 of the INT Preferences column.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns the error detail ALONE at index 0 — no envelope. Other failures return {success:0, errorCode, errorType} at index 0 then this detail at index 1: 2000 'Bad preference' (errorType 2, logged), 2001 unhandled (errorType 5, CATCH, logged).

rowsets.name: Preference
rowsets.description: On success: the value now stored, decoded from the row by HC6.DirectMessagePreference(Preferences).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET Preferences = (Preferences & ~0xC000) | (@preference * 0x4000) WHERE id = @userId (line 56); the table trigger stamps updatedAt so the row re-syncs to the hasher's devices.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on refusal (line 45) and in the CATCH (line 65).
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
